newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AWT World in HK$32.76 mln bonds issue.
newsitem.headline: AWT World in HK$32.76 mln bonds issue.

text.p: Air and sea freight forwarder AWT World Transport Holdings Ltd said on Monday it proposed to issue HK$32.76 million worth of convertible bonds maturing on May 21, 1999.
The bonds will carry the rights to convert into shares of the company at a conversion price of HK$0.91 per share subject to adjustment, AWT said in a statement.
The bonds will bear interest at a rate of 9.5 percent per annum and will be payable quarterly, it said.
AWT said it will issue 36 million shares assuming full conversion of the bonds, representing 10.68 percent of the company's enlarged share capital.
AWT chairman David Leung's stake in the company will be diluted to 22.95 percent from 25.69 percent on full conversion of the bonds.
The company said the bond issue is expected to be completed on December 31.
Net proceeds will be used for general working capital with respect to the increased business activities of the air flight and related businesses, it said.
